model.title: American Franchise Act
model.meta: Education and Workforce Committee · Rep. Kevin Hern (R-OK)

summary.text: The bill would clarify when a franchisor can be treated as a joint employer of a franchisee's workers under federal labor law. Under the bill, a franchisor would be considered a joint employer only if it actually possesses and exercises substantial, regular control over at least one essential term of employment, such as wages, benefits, hours, hiring, discharge, discipline, supervision, or direction. The bill would amend both the National Labor Relations Act and the Fair Labor Standards Act to apply this standard, and it would not apply to proceedings begun before the bill's enactment.
